question: Is she for questioning in Shiva — bound with selves yet self-seeing?
premises: not for questioning is she, in Shiva by his greatness glorified
indeed the Shaiva great power, bound with selves, stands
true, covering-natured, but peaceful — this one self-nature-seeing
inference: Glorified yet bound, covering yet peaceful, she sees self-nature unquestioned.
plain_english: But not for questioning is she, in Shiva by his greatness glorified — indeed the Shaiva great power, bound with selves, stands; true, covering-natured, but peaceful — this one self-nature-seeing.
